'''''Leia, Princess of Alderaan''''' is a young-adult novel written by [[Claudia Gray]] and published by [[Disney–Lucasfilm Press]]. It was released on [[September 1]], [[2017]], as part of [[Journey to Star Wars: The Last Jedi|Journey to ''Star Wars: The Last Jedi'']].
